prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a hit while turning left claim. Injury: knee injury. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1207; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Reviewed the loss report for a left-turn collision at a signalized intersection. Insured vehicle states it turned left on a permissive green arrow and was struck by an oncoming vehicle that did not appear to yield. Scene photos requested from both parties.

Entry 2: Spoke with the claimant by phone. Claimant reports a knee injury from the impact, describes pain when bending and some swelling. Claimant is not represented by an attorney and states they are handling the matter directly. Advised claimant of the process for submitting medical records and bills.

Entry 3: Received the police report. It lists the other driver as cited for failure to yield during a left turn. Witness statement from a pedestrian at the corner is consistent with the insured's account. Liability position is strengthening in favor of the insured.

Entry 4: Claimant emailed a photo of the knee with visible bruising and a copy of an urgent care visit summary noting a possible ligament strain. Requested an MRI report and follow-up care notes before evaluating the bodily injury portion of the claim. Sent claimant a written explanation of the documents still needed.

Entry 5: Vehicle inspection completed. Damage consistent with a side impact to the driver's door and front quarter panel. Repair estimate received and forwarded for review. Bodily injury claim remains open pending the MRI results and a follow-up appointment with the treating provider. Diary set for follow-up with claimant in two weeks.
